title: host_parasite_interactions: genome-scale metabolic modelling of host–parasite (malaria) interactions
description: MATLAB pipeline (matTFA, redGEM/redHUMAN, CPLEX) to reconstruct context-specific genome-scale metabolic models of the human hepatocyte and of Plasmodium falciparum, build an integrated host–parasite model, and perform host gene-essentiality analysis for parasite survival. Companion code for Maurizio, Masid et al., 'Host cell CRISPR genomics and modelling reveal shared metabolic vulnerabilities in the intracellular development of Plasmodium falciparum and related hemoparasites', Nat Commun 15:6145 (2024). The code is licensed Apache-2.0; bundled third-party data files carry their own licenses — see DATA_LICENSES.md.
